name: 透明抠图（PNG/WebP 透明底产品提取）

prompt_template.type: product extraction onto fully transparent background (official GPT-Image-2.5 cutout recipe, verbatim)
prompt_template.subject: Extract the product from the input image and isolate it on a fully transparent background
prompt_template.output: centered product, crisp silhouette, no halos/fringing
prompt_template.preserve: product geometry and label legibility exactly
prompt_template.constraints: Add only light polishing. Do not add a solid backdrop, checkerboard, scenery, or shadow. Do not restyle the product; remove the background and preserve clean alpha transparency.

defaults.api_params: requires background=transparent + output_format=png (or webp); relay endpoints expose this as request parameters — api channel passes them through when supported, manual mode notes them in the pack

webp-transparent.description: WebP 透明（更小体积，支持真半透明——动图残影场景优先）
